integrity: The classification follows exactly from the unit-group exponent criterion \(\lambda(pq)\mid pq-k\). Infinitude uses Dirichlet's theorem and the asymptotic uses the prime number theorem for arithmetic progressions. Finite computation is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only squarefree semiprime members of Knödel sets. Prime powers and members with at least three prime factors remain outside the claim.
title: Semiprime phase transition for Knödel sets
